claim_scope: Physical W7900 packed multi-request AR prefill on Qwen3.8-27B Q4_K_M/BF16-KV. Control and candidate differ only by the hip_gfx1100 package value GGUF_PACKED_PREFILL_FINAL_OUTPUT_MASK. The retained result is an exact launch and device sub-window reduction, not a throughput rate.
decision: Enable GGUF_PACKED_PREFILL_FINAL_OUTPUT_MASK on hip_gfx1100 (audit packet F1). Intermediate slot-fair bounded prefill rounds now skip output norm, the full Q6 LM head, and sampling; only each slot's final tail is sampled. Token trajectories, request ownership, cancellation, admission, and compaction are unchanged.

software.gfx1151_precedent: same capability retained there; this packet qualifies it independently on the W7900

reachability.note: At the canonical 36-token suite encoding widths 1-7 are single-chunk and the mask is a no-op; width 8 is the first splitting wave. Longer prompts split at every width.

state_differentials.comparator: scripts/diff_differential_arms.py (semantic axes; address-dependent K/V byte dumps excluded)

two_round_64_48.note: Both arms report tokens_exact false against the strict c1 teacher on this short shape; the verdict and the packed trajectories are identical across arms, so it is the documented pre-existing packed-versus-c1 divergence and not an effect of the mask.

route_trace.harness: rocprofv3 --kernel-trace over scripts/gguf_packed_ar_bench.py p512 native_c8, 1 measured run, 1 decode step, cached build
route_trace.interpretation: A p512 C8 prefill plans six bounded rounds; the control samples the full head once per round plus once for the decode step (7), the candidate samples it once for the final round plus the decode step (2).

mask_engaged_widths_4_8.route_profile: q4_selected_pair_candidate (package floor-driven; no candidate env set)
mask_engaged_widths_4_8.note: width 8 splits prefill into [256, 32], so the mask engages; width 4 is single-chunk.

single_chunk_widths_3_5_6_7.note: These widths are single-chunk at the canonical encoding, so the mask never engages; this run is route-level non-regression only, and it reproduces the pre-flip ledger figures.

numerical_gate.harness_status_caveat: Both runs report status invalid_or_screen_only / measurement_valid false because of three pre-existing harness blockers already recorded in docs/REFACTOR.md (route manifest is evidentiary rather than runtime-profile resolved, the adapter omits the complete exact control-plane record schema, and fresh task and BF16-relative verdicts are unavailable). They are properties of the gate harness, not of this change, and applied equally before it.

performance.harness: scripts/gguf_packed_ar_bench.py native_c8 p512/d128, 1 warmup + 3 measured, counterbalanced control/candidate/candidate/control
performance.interpretation: Flat within session drift and not a throughput claim. The four arms decline monotonically in wall-clock order regardless of which arm ran, and the two control arms differ from each other by 0.77% on prefill, more than the 0.18% pooled candidate-control difference. This matches the gfx1151 precedent, where the same capability produced 0.033-0.219% pooled prefill wall changes and was retained as an exact launch reduction rather than a rate win.

correctness.red_green: tests/test_gfx1151_backend.py::test_packed_prefill_final_output_mask_is_qualified_on_both_backends and the gfx1100 assertion in tests/test_qwen35_gguf_mtp2_seam.py were written RED (asserting the qualified state) and failed on the package value before the flip; both are green after it.
correctness.focused_bundle: 187 passed: gfx1151 backend, mtp2 seam, packed AR state oracle, packed execution manifest, packed prefill grouping probe, slab probe, packed AR bench, packed decode graph

limitations: Prefill rate, TTFT, and decode rate are flat within drift; no throughput improvement is claimed.
The mask-engaged numerical gate covers widths 4 and 8 on the canonical suite; widths 1-7 at that encoding are single-chunk and cannot exercise the mask, though longer prompts split at every width.
The production-profile harness cannot emit a binding qualification verdict until its three recorded control-plane blockers close; the numerical evidence here is a passing screen.
disposition: retained; GGUF_PACKED_PREFILL_FINAL_OUTPUT_MASK = True on hip_gfx1100; the unmasked path remains for packages that do not set the capability
